checked_profile.summary: Refinancing with education requirements that distinguish a borrower’s own loans from a child’s education debt.
checked_profile.scope: These selected help-center facts cover education eligibility and servicing. They are not a complete underwriting checklist or confirmation of rates, fees, state availability or cosigner-release terms.

facts.label: Your education loans
facts.text: Earnest’s guidance generally requires a completed associate degree or higher, and considers applicants graduating in the current semester. It also describes circumstances where students still in school may refinance undergraduate loans; confirm which debts qualify.

facts.label: A child’s education loans
facts.text: A parent applicant does not need their own degree. Earnest asks that the child has completed their education or is in the last semester before graduation.

facts.label: Lending and servicing
facts.text: Earnest’s help center identifies Earnest Operations LLC or FinWise Bank as the loan maker and Earnest Operations LLC, supported by MOHELA, as the servicer. Confirm the legal lender in your documents.

questions: Which of my existing loans and degree programs qualify?
What is the full cost of the refinance compared with keeping my current loans?
Who will be legally responsible, and can any cosigner be released under this specific agreement?
